Container.Name: Sunroom
Container.Overview: A family wall calendar for a shared screen at home, with everyone's own devices as the second screen. Calendars, lists, tasks, meals, countdowns and photos, on your own server, with no accounts anywhere. Open it, then set up your household.

Config.Name: Web page
Config.Description: The port your devices open Sunroom on.

Config.Name: Sunroom's data
Config.Description: The calendar, the nightly backups and the photos all live here.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: The household's time zone, for example America/New_York. It can be set in the app too.

Config.Name: Install kind
Config.Description: How Sunroom words the way to update it.
